description: This file defines a serializer class 'TimeSpanCodec' for serializing and deserializing the TimeSpan type within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods for writing and reading TimeSpan values to and from a wire protocol, utilizing fixed 64-bit integer representation of Ticks.

classes.name: TimeSpanCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for serializing and deserializing TimeSpan objects in Orleans serialization.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a TimeSpan value into the writer with a specified field ID delta, using fixed 64-bit wire type.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a TimeSpan value from the reader, ensuring the wire type is fixed 64-bit and reading the Ticks.
